inventory.visualPurpose: The Gram-negative lab algorithm tree (book 139, lower half)
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The printed decision tree: root 'Gram ⊝ (pink)' splitting by morphology into Diplococci (aerobic; oxidase and maltose fermentation → N gonorrhoeae + Moraxella vs N meningitidis), Coccobacilli (aerobic: H influenzae, B pertussis, Pasteurella, Brucella, F tularensis, A baumannii), Curved rods (oxidase ⊕: 42°C → C jejuni, alkaline → V cholerae, urease → H pylori), and Bacilli (lactose fermentation → oxidase → H2S on TSI agar, with fast/slow lactose split and the Yersinia superscript-a footnote 'Pleomorphic rod/coccobacillus'; 'Important tests are in bold. Important pathogens are in bold italics.'). Pure vector.
